findings.evidence: Diffractive/Basic.lean:55 `namespace ExclKinematics`; Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:66 `noncomputable def xiSkew`. Roadmap Convention 1 names exactly this trap ("two different momentum fractions ... a lemma about one is applied to the other").
findings.fix: Wrap the diffractive declarations in `namespace Diffractive` inside the file (keeping the roadmap-mandated names `xi`, `beta`), so the diffractive surface is `Diffractive.xi`/`Diffractive.beta` and is not offered as dot notation on an exclusive event.
findings.issue: `xi`, `beta`, `MX2` are declared in `namespace ExclKinematics`, so every DVCS/DVMP event gets `K.xi g = -Δ·q/P·q` sitting next to `K.xiSkew g`, the skewness that the exclusive literature also calls ξ. The PR description itself says these live in `namespace Diffractive`; the code does not.

findings.evidence: Both are exact with only symmetry of `g`: `Q2 + MX2 - tMom = -2 g K.delta K.q` (expand `MX2_eq_q_sub_delta` and cancel `g δ δ`), and `Q2 + W2 - M2 = 2 g K.p K.q` from `W2_expand` (Kinematics/Basic.lean:79). Roadmap 0.1 lists both as exact identities of the claimed section (README.md:285-287).
findings.fix: Add `beta_eq_Q2_div_Q2_add_MX2_sub_tMom (g) (hg : g.IsSymm) (K) : K.beta g = K.Q2 g / (K.Q2 g + K.MX2 g - K.tMom g)` and the companion `xi` form `(K.Q2 g + K.MX2 g - K.tMom g) / (K.Q2 g + K.W2 g - K.M2 g)`.
findings.issue: `beta` has no characteristic lemma relating it to the quantities defined in scope: `MX2` and `tMom` interact with nothing, so a consumer cannot get from `beta` to the measurable `M_X²`, `t` without unfolding the definition. The same holds for `xi` against `W2`/`M2`.

findings.evidence: roadmap/EpsilonEridaniRoadmaps/Diffraction/README.md:279 `- \`M_X² = (q + Δ)²\` and \`M_Y² = P'²\`.`; grep for `MY2` in code/EpsilonEridani returns nothing.
findings.fix: Add `MY2 (g) (K) : ℝ := g K.pPrime K.pPrime` with `MY2_def ... := (rfl)`, mirroring `MX2`/`MX2_def`.
findings.issue: `M_Y² = P'²` — part of the same variable set of the claimed roadmap section 0.1 and needed by 0.2 (`t_min(ξ, M, M_Y)`) and 0.4 (target-elastic/dissociative partition) — is not exposed, although `MX2` is.

summary: The removal of the duplicated `Q2`/`hqLepton` surface in favour of the `DisKinematics` parent is clean and leaves no compatibility residue. Two interface problems remain: the diffractive variables are attached to the shared `ExclKinematics` namespace where `K.xi` collides semantically with the skewness `K.xiSkew`, and `beta`/`MX2`/`tMom` are left with no lemma connecting them.
